Verse of the Day
I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
Isaiah 44:22
Quote of the Day
"Wake up each day with purpose and confidence, knowing that Jesus will walk with you."
President Susan H. Porter | 1 Apr 2026General Conference
